projects.name: Financial Tracker
projects.description: Backend REST API using FastAPI (Python) with JWT auth and per-user data isolation. Handles transactions, accounts, and categories with search, filtering, pagination, and dashboard visualizations. Dockerized for deployment to Fly.io, with GitHub Actions CI/CD automating tests and deployment.

projects.name: My Book List
projects.description: Book catalog app with user registration, email verification, and JWT (Spring Security + BCrypt). Built as a layered Java Spring Boot project. Integrates Open Library API for trending and searchable books, storing book metadata in PostgreSQL. CI/CD and deployment on Fly.io.

projects.name: OHS Remote (Capstone) - Safety Compliance Platform
projects.description: REST APIs for generating branded OHS manuals and handling order workflow, logo uploads, and secure document downloads (token-based). Uses MySQL, SQLAlchemy, Alembic migrations; containerized via Docker Compose. All endpoints documented with Swagger/OpenAPI.
